title: Grill — Create all PRs: right title/body, right base, base-aware PR link

real-prs.title: The goal says Create all PRs "is not creating the PR" when the target isn't the default branch. What actually happened to the two real PRs?
real-prs.display: Both opened, but against `main` with the step title and an empty body

base-precedence.title: Rank the sources Create all PRs should take a repository's base branch from, first match wins.
base-precedence.display: 1. The base branch recorded when the task was created  2. The base in the agent's newest matching PR link  3. The remote's default branch (`origin/HEAD`, then the provider's default)

store-base.title: Record the base branch's name when a task is created?

head-base.title: When the task's base is `HEAD` (no branch picked), what should be recorded as its base branch?
head-base.display: The checked-out branch, but only if it exists on the remote

missing-base.title: The chosen base doesn't exist on the remote (deleted, never pushed, typo in the agent's link). What happens to that repository?
missing-base.display: Fail that repository with a clear message

attribution.title: How should Create all PRs match a proposal to a repository?
attribution.display: Link match OR a `Repository:` label; drop the blind single-target fallback

proposal-scope.title: Which run's proposal counts for each repository?
proposal-scope.display: Per repository: its newest matching proposal from any run

no-proposal.title: No proposal matches a repository. What should its PR get?
no-proposal.display: The root task's title (the pipeline parent's, for a step) and an empty body, marked "no proposal" in the confirm list
no-proposal.note: For the sake of a comparison, current behavior is using Pipeline name in the PR title (wrong)

confirm-list.title: Keep Create all PRs one-click, or show a short confirm list first?

single-chip-base.title: Should the single-repo "Create PR" chip also prefill the composer's base from the proposal?
single-chip-base.display: Yes, same base rules as Create all PRs

link-format.title: Which link should the prompt ask the agent to print?
link-format.display: Per-forge destination links: GitHub `compare/…?quick_pull=1`, GitLab `target_branch`, Bitbucket `dest`

prompt-names-base.title: Should the prompt name the base agetor already knows?
prompt-names-base.display: Name the known base, with "unless you moved the branch onto another base"

base-line.title: Should the agent also print an explicit `Base: <branch>` line?

multi-pr-per-repo.title: The real reply proposed two PRs for the app repo (a second branch). Support more than one PR per repository?
multi-pr-per-repo.display: In scope: one PR per matching proposal

owner-pipeline.title: Your pipeline's "Commit And Push" step text is an old copy of the single-repo prompt. What do we do about it?
owner-pipeline.display: Nothing in code; link attribution covers it. I'll update my own step text myself.

c-no-backfill.title: Existing tasks
c-no-backfill.value: No backfill. Existing tasks have no stored base and fall through to the next source in the Q2 order.

c-normalize.title: Base name normalization
c-normalize.value: A picked `origin/develop` is stored as `develop` (the remote prefix is stripped when it names a configured remote). Links are URL-decoded (`release%2F1.2` → `release/1.2`).

c-legacy-links.title: Old transcripts
c-legacy-links.value: Old `pull/new/<branch>` links still attribute a proposal (by owner/repo and head), with no base taken from them.

c-tests.title: Acceptance tests
c-tests.value: Unit tests for link parsing, attribution and base precedence. Updated prompt tests. A new `FAKE_CLAUDE_*_PROMPT_MARKER` that emits proposal text on the assistant stream, plus an e2e that drives Create all PRs and asserts each PR's **title, body and base** through the GitHub stub's recorded POST bodies, including a repository with a non-default base.

c-docs.title: Docs updated in the same change
c-docs.value: `docs/architecture/multi-repo-tasks.md` (pull-create section), `docs/architecture/run-panel.md` (Create all PRs), `docs/architecture/persistence.md` (new server-managed column, if Q3 = store), the CLAUDE.md server-managed list, the `commitPushPrompt` and `pr-proposal.ts` header comments, and the Commit & push tooltip. `docs/plans/multi-repo-tasks.md` A10 marked superseded.

c-pipeline-step-stamp.title: PRs opened from a pipeline step's panel
c-pipeline-step-stamp.value: Unchanged: a PR opened from a step is stamped on the step only (already documented). Out of scope.
